name: Alpinestars
verdict: Owned by Alpinestars S.p.A. (Mazzarolo family). Nothing found.
note: Italian motorsport protection-gear maker (Asolo/Maser, Italy, founded 1963); supplier of race suits, gloves and boots to Nissan Formula E Team. Rating note: family ownership is stated by the company's own about page (claim alpinestars-record, reused from the alpinestars-c/alpinestars-h records); no dated shareholder register published. Bloomberg reported in September 2026 that Asian private-equity firms including FountainVest and HSG were considering bids valuing the company at about €1 billion; no sale was announced. Same owner as 'alpinestars-c' and 'alpinestars-h'. Long-standing partner named in Jaguar TCS Racing's Season 12 launch release (media.jlr.com, 22 Oct 2025) and on the club's partners page. No state stake or human-rights finding identified.
